title: Yun Yaad Na Kar Ghar Me Sughra Ali Akber Ku
body:
Yun Yaad Na Kar Ghar Me Sughra Ali Akber Ku
Pardes Me Aada Ne Maara Ali Akber Ku
1.Majboor tera Bhai Seene Pe Seena Khayi
Taiyar Tha Aane Ku Afsoos Aajal Aayi
Tha yaad Bhot Din Se Wada Ali Abker Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Taiyari Thi Shadi Ki Jab Waqt-e-Aajal Aaya
Barchi Me Kaleja Bhi Seene Se Nikal Aaya
Afsoos Na Raaz Aaya Sehra Ali Akber Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Puche Koi Sarwar Se Kya Haal Howa Us Dum
Jab Mout Pe Akber Ki Zainab Ne Kiya Matam
Kis Tarah Bhulati Thi Laila Ali Akber Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Aankhou Ki Basarath Bhi Shabbir Gawa Baithe
Akber Ke Janaze Par Rokar Yehin Khete They
Kis Waqt Me Khismat Ne Cheena Ali Akber Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Seene Se Lahu Jaari Hum Shakle Paiyambar Ke
Dekha Toh Phuphi Royi Khene Laagi Sarwar
Tha Koun Shaqi Jisne Maara Ali Akber Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Aathara Baras Paala Zainab Ne Muradou Se
Yeh Daag-e-Judaai Ka Zainab Se Uthe Kaise
Dum Todhte Zainab Ne Dekha Ali Akber Ku
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Rehan Madine Me Jis Waqt Qabar Pahunchi
Pardes Me Akber Ke Seene Pe Laahi Barchi
Taa Umr Na Payengi Sughra Ali Akber Ku
